resources.resource: Build Lead and trained stage crew

step.action: Confirm that the Sound Lead released the empty stage.
Close the stage work area to people not on the trained crew.
Dismantle the stage, scaffold, guards, access components, braces, and anchors in the manufacturer-approved reverse sequence.
Put every fastener and small stage part in its assigned hardware bin.
Stack and secure each structural component in its transport group.
Have the Build Lead count every component against the stage inventory.

passWhen.criterion: Every stage and scaffold component is accounted for and secured in its transport group.
Every fastener and anchor is in its assigned hardware bin.
The former stage footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
